purpose: R249 non-financial HS300 stock-level low-skewness factor versus a matched quality-cash control

universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

factor.formula: stock_skew_60d_low = -skewness(r_t, ..., r_t_minus_59), where r_t = adjusted_close_t / adjusted_close_t_minus_1 - 1; higher means lower or more negative trailing return skewness
factor.pit_rule: factor on date t uses only returns through date t close; fewer than 60 valid returns or nonfinite skewness remain null; execution is T+1 open

pit_audit.rule: factor on date t uses only returns through t close; fewer than 60 valid returns or nonfinite skewness remain null

samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2023-2026 curve
samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2023-2026 curve

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four components proportionally
execution.stitching: two segment returns compounded into one curve; first day of each later segment skipped

caveats: Simple raw-return skewness is not residual idiosyncratic skewness and is sensitive to outliers.
The 60-trading-day rolling window can be noisy and overlaps materially across consecutive dates.
The factor retains moderate correlation with volatility, momentum and trend-efficiency signals.
Financial values in the matched control are current snapshots and the industry snapshot is not historical PIT.
The full curve is stitched from two system-engine segments; segment boundaries can reset an open position.
Trade P&L shares are contribution diagnostics from two segments each starting at 1,000,000 notional, not a compounded-return decomposition.
The factor is research-only until every preregistered gate passes; passing would justify paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
